jing (ML): Quick sync — we're evaluating whether to onboard `llama3a-70b-int8` for the Dedicated pilot next sprint. Can folks fill in a short priority score + gating checklist by EOD? We need perf/quality/cost inputs.

sam (PM): Heads up — if we greenlight this it should target the EU Dedicated pilot (sales asked). Need an enterprise SLA callout in the intake.

noah (SRE): Proposal for quick rubric: accuracy/quality=40, perf/latency=30, infra-risk=20, cost=10. Use 0-10 per axis then weighted.

devon (Infra): FYI 70B + int8 usually fits on A800/A100 but check KV cache growth. Recommend two smoke configs: q8_0 (default) and q4_0 (fallback) to measure memory + p95. Example smoke cmd: `./smoke_run --model llama3a-70b-int8 --quant q8_0 --batch 8 --seq 2048`

maria (Eval): I'll run our core eval suites: summarization, instr-follow, hallucination-rate, and our conv-qa throughput tests. Plan: run full baseline (float) vs int8 variants, measure delta on Rouge/F1 + hallucination delta. Command I'll use: 
```
./run_eval --model llama3a-70b-int8 --suites summarization,instr,hallucination,convqa --batch 8 --seq_len 2048 --save outputs/llama3a-70b-int8
```

triage-bot: Created INTAKE-3421 and added label `prio-candidate`. Link: https://redwood.internal/INTAKE-3421

jing (ML): Assigning owners: @maria -> evals, @devon -> infra smoke + perf numbers, @noah -> gating rubric consolidation. Sam please add SLA notes to the ticket. Target: preliminary results by Tue EOD. :eyes:

noah (SRE): Ack. Quick perf target question — what's the latency SLO for Dedicated pilot? p95 < 500ms or are we aiming lower?

devon (Infra): Realistically p95 ~600-900ms on 70B for typical request sizes on a single GPU; with batching we can improve throughput but increase tail. For latency-critical routes we should recommend a 13B variant fallback.

sam (PM): Ok that's expected. We'll document fallback policy in the ticket and flag customers that need sub-300ms. Also need cost est for Dedicated capacity — @devon can you add rough vGPU hours estimate?

maria (Eval): Will post initial numbers to INTAKE-3421: float baseline vs q8_0 vs q4_0; I'll include rouge/f1/delta, hallucination%, and per-sample token throughput. Expect first dump by Tue morning, full analysis Tue EOD.

jing (ML): Thanks all — please update the ticket rather than pinging here, I'll triage after numbers land. :thumbsup:
